The structure of Li3Mn6O6F3 (reduced formula LiMn2OF) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Li centers coordinated by four O neighbors, Mn centers with four neighbors (one F and three O), and two distinct O environments: one with eight neighbors (2 F, 4 Li, 2 Mn) and one with ten (4 F, 4 Li, 2 Mn). A single three-dimensional geometric neighbor graph spans all 18 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between O-centered 8- and 10-vertex polyhedra.
